title: Warnings and Winners From the IMF Meetings
executive_summary: Morgan Stanley analysts discuss the IMF Spring Meetings, highlighting potential underpricing of growth risks from higher energy costs and central bank tightening, while emerging markets appear resilient.

asset_allocation_views: Caution on growth due to energy costs and potential over-tightening
risk_assessments: Growth hit from higher energy costs
Risk of too much tightening by central banks
profile_data.market_outlook: Resilient emerging markets, but potential for growth risks and market volatility
